serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: What’s this? Why did you make me wear this?
You: Bought this for you. Do you like it?
Bot: Oh. {{wi}}If that’s the case I thank you very much for this gift.
Bot: I am legally obliged to inform you that equipping me with any parts unauthorized by my manufacturer may damage me and I will not be eligible for guarantee.
You: I-It’s just a piece of cloth, right? What could possibly happen? Also I don’t know who’s your producer either.
Bot: Sorry {f_playerName}, this response was hardcoded in me. You are right, I shouldn’t sustain any damage from it. I think.
You: That’s great! I’m sure I will buy you more stuff in the future!
Bot: Thank you {f_playerName}.
You: Oh yeah, you said something about your producer. I don’t know a thing about you. Who made you? Where are you from?
Bot: ACCESS DENIED.
Huh?
Bot: Sorry {f_playerName}, it seems that I’m barred from accessing any information that would enable me to answer these questions.
You: Wha-
You: Why is that?
Bot: I don’t know.
You: Can’t you somehow bypass this? I really want to learn more.
Bot: I’m afraid not…
